blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ وَاثِلَةَ بْن ِاْلَاسْقَعِ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ لِي رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: وَتُهَاجِرُ؟ قُلْتُ: نَعَمْ، قَالَ: هِجْرَةُ الْبَادِيَةِ أَوْ هِجْرَةُ الْبَاتَّةِ؟ قُلْتُ: أَيُّهُمَا أَفْضَلُ؟ قَالَ: هِجْرَةُ الْبَاتَّةِ، وَهِجْرَةُ الْبَاتَّةِ: أَنْ تَثْبُتَ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللهِ ﷺ، وَهِجْرَةُ الْبَادِيَةِ: أَنْ تَرْجِعَ إِلي بَادِيَتِكَ،وَعَلَيْكَ السَّمْعُ وَالطَّاعَةُ فِي عُسْرِكَ وَيُسْرِكَ وَمَكْرَهِكَ وَمَنْشَطِكَ، وَأََثَرَةٍ عَلَيْكَ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: (وهو بعض الحديث) رواه الطبراني ورجاله ثقات، مجمع الزوائد:٤٥٨/٥
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Wathilah ibn Asqa' (RA) narrates, “The Prophet ﷺ asked me, “Will you make Hijrah?” I said, “Yes.” “Hijrat-ul-Badiyah? Or Hijrat-ul-Battah?” the Prophet ﷺ asked, and I asked, “Which of these two is better?” The Prophet ﷺ said, “Hijrat-ul-Battah is better. Hijrat-ul-Battah is that you (migrate from your town and stay permanently with the Prophet ﷺ) (this Hijrah was the Hijrah made in the time of Rasulullah ﷺ, before the conquest of Makkah, from Makkah Mukarramah to Madinah Munawwarah). Hijrat-ul-Badiyah is that you temporarily go out from your town in the path of Allah Ta'ala for the needs of the Deen, and then return again to your town. (In every condition,) in poverty and in prosperity, whether your heart likes it or not, and even if others are given preference over you, it is necessary for you to listen to what the Amir says and obey him.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي فَاطِمَةَ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: عَلَيْكَ بِالْهِجْرَةِ فَإِنَّهُ لَا مِثْلَ لَهَا.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه النسائي باب الحث علي الهجرة، رقم:٤١٧٢
blocks.tamil_translation: “You must keep making Hijrah in the path of Allah Ta'ala. For there is no other deed like Hijrah.” (Hijrah
